_comment: Per-MODULE champion registry for the Ladrillo benchmark. Promotion is manual and
'tag' must have a frozen snapshot under benchmark/reference/<tag>/.
Champions are per module because a change that improves one module and leaves the
others untouched should not silently take credit for them.

ais.why: calib 1.6.0 + CMIP7 driver migration (Marcus 2026-08-28). NOT a fit improvement: R-hat 1.017->1.006, ESS 953->1201, ssp585@2100 AIS 2.430->2.045x lit; but TE hindcast 1.245x WORSE and AIS 1.142x WORSE. Promoted for COHERENCE — L14 is fit to drivers that no longer exist in the tree.
